sloka: मारुतोद्धूतशिखरै: प्रनृत्त इव पर्वत: ।पादपै: पत्ऺत्रपुष्पाणि सृजद्भिरभितो नदीम् ॥ २.९५.८॥
transliteration: mārutoddhūtaśikharai: pranṛtta iva parvata: ।pādapai: patऺtrapuṣpāṇi sṛjadbhirabhito nadīm ॥ 2.95.8॥

translations.english: With the trees whose tops are swayed by the wind, the mountain was as if dancing, shedding leaves and flowers all around the river.
